performance.verdict: No paid activity; 5 overdue milestones now block revenue entirely.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site Live, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting — all unstarted per data.
Zero paid spend across Meta and Google for all 28 days; $0 CPL is meaningless — no budget has ever activated for this client.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for 6 consecutive days (Sep 1–6) after averaging ~3.5/day Aug 10–29 — a confirmed profile engagement stoppage.
GHL shows 106 contacts and 36 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake pipeline exists but no consults are booking; source unclear with no paid traffic.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no paid launch is possible until resolved.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site Live, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — were due July 31–Aug 1 and remain incomplete as of Sep 7. Zero paid spend has run in 28 days, meaning $0 of the ~$6,500/mo ad budget has activated. Success is defined as all 5 milestones marked complete and a confirmed go-live date in place by Sep 14. Nacer is the responsible owner; Sohib to confirm escalation path.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing: 0 actions for 6 straight days after averaging 3.5/day — check for suspension or suppression.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to exactly 0 from Sep 1–6 after a consistent 3–9 actions/day throughout August. This is the only active lead source while paid channels are offline, making it critical. Log into Google Business Profile today and check for a suspension notice, pending verification, or owner flag. Success check: GBP actions resume above 2/day within 3 days of fix, re-check Sep 10.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL: 36 opportunities, 0 appointments booked — identify why consults are not converting from pipeline to calendar.

Success is defined as at least 1 test lead successfully booking a consult end-to-end by Sep 14, ahead of any paid go-live.
